description: Angular component for file input handling, including drag-and-drop, file reading, size and extension filtering, and integration with flowjs for uploads.

classes.name: FileInputComponent
classes.description: Angular component for file input with drag-and-drop, size/extension filtering, and file reading capabilities.

methods.name: ngAfterViewInit
methods.description: Initializes event subscription for flowjs file addition and manages multiple file mode.

methods.name: readerAsFile
methods.description: Reads a file as text or binary, applies content conversion if provided.

methods.name: checkMaxSize
methods.description: Checks if a file exceeds the maximum allowed size.

methods.name: filterFile
methods.description: Filters files based on allowed extensions.

methods.name: registerOnTouched
methods.description: Registers callback for touch event (not implemented).

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Sets disabled state of the component.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Writes a value to the component, handling file object or filename.

methods.name: ngOnChanges
methods.description: Handles changes to input properties, especially existingFileName.

methods.name: updateModel
methods.description: Updates the form model with current file data.

methods.name: updateMultipleFileMode
methods.description: Configures flowjs for single or multiple file uploads.
